# bunnynet_pullzone_cache_purge (Action)

This action allows users to purge cache for a bunny.net Pullzone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "bunnynet_pullzone_cache_purge" "website-assets" {
  config {
    pullzone = bunnynet_pullzone.website.id
    tag      = "assets"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pullzone` (Number) The ID of the Pullzone to purge.

### Optional

- `tag` (String) A tag to purge. All cached objects with a matching `CDN-Tag` header will be purged.
